Temperature 7548 +/- 2496 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17851: effective temperature 7548 +/- 2496 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.495) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
